mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals stronger future demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 5.5% for 3 months, it signals a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the effect diminishes in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 4%) and rising UNRATE (above 4.5%) signals dual pressures of easy money and tight labor, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction occurs but returns are positive, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4% for 2 months signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS decline occurs in a late-cycle expansion but returns are positive, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Employment rises but 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 5% for 2 months, it signals tight labor markets and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 5% but returns are positive, or the effect is not significant.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and falling supply index (INDPRO) signals inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The combination occurs but returns are negative, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 3% for 1 month signals accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS drop occurs in post-shock but returns are negative, or the effect is not significant.
